mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: 60-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 8.0%), reduced consumer spending and corporate profits drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS rising) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is rising (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 90 (INDPRO < 90) indicates manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (high HOUST and strong GDPC1), market anticipation of economic slowdown drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals delayed Fed response, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising CPIAUCSL and low FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns: 20-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
